pk.context: 150 mg oral, steady state, healthy adults

tell: Its extended-release capsule gives a lower, later peak than twice-daily immediate-release venlafaxine, allowing once-daily dosing.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is about 45%, and food does not affect it. It is 27% bound to plasma proteins and extensively metabolized in the liver, with about 87% of a dose recovered in urine within 48 hours.
A hydrochloride salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 277.4. Its solubility in water is very high, at 572 mg/mL.
An NDA extended-release capsule in 37.5, 75 and 150 mg strengths, taken once a day.

Boxed warning for suicidal thoughts and behavior in pediatric and young adult patients. Contraindicated with MAOIs, including linezolid, and in hypersensitivity; nausea and somnolence are most common.
In adults: major depressive disorder, generalized anxiety disorder, social anxiety disorder and panic disorder.
Its action is unclear, but is thought to potentiate serotonin and norepinephrine in the central nervous system by blocking their reuptake.
The generic name begins with V and has eleven letters.
